240-5470-8249-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

6495-7084-8232.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Alharu trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Alharu trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
6495-7084-8232.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

891-4247-8207.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

147-728-3905.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-728-3905.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-1981-2415-4699.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

533-3129-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
533-3129-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1003-2626-4986-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1895-4399-4518-6823.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

3249-5173-5256-5542.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2445-3099-4762-4772.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2757-3182-7435.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
1270-2757-3182-7435.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
1270-2757-3182-7435.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding a land card.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability, giving it lifelink until end of turn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Plant, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing the three Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2539-3094-4659-6633-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-6633-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1753-2366-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
1753-2366-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2292-5220-6578-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
2292-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

2438-3197-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
2438-3197-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2590-5776-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2590-5776-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

2421-3168-5231-6711.manaNeeded: {R}{R} if Sabin is in your graveyard or {2}{R} plus commander tax if applicable otherwise
2421-3168-5231-6711.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional card in hand.
2421-3168-5231-6711.description:
If Sabin is in your graveyard, cast it for its blitz cost by paying {R}{R} and discarding a card. Otherwise, cast Sabin either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Sabin and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Choose not to return Sabin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sabin dies, if it was cast using its blitz ability, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

1242-2228-3143-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1242-2228-3143-4613.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Xavier Sal using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

1456-2034-5043-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

222-527-955-2511.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-955-2511.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1879-2034-3372-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1879-2034-3372-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2392-2743-4483.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
Silverskin Armor attached to Biovisionary.
2392-2743-4483.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

4094-4365-4636-5770.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
4094-4365-4636-5770.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-2005-3263.notablePrerequisites: Jetfire has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
114-2005-3263.description:
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding at least {3} and converting it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Repeat.

2773-3760.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Broodhatch Nantuko indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Broodhatch Nantuko.
2773-3760.description:
Give Broodhatch Nantuko indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Broodhatch Nantuko.
Broodhatch Nantuko triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, causing the Insect to deal one damage to Broodhatch Nantuko.
Repeat from step 3.

690-1162.notablePrerequisites:
Angelic Enforcer does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-1162.description:
Declare Angelic Enforcer as an attacker.
Angelic Enforcer triggers, doubling your life total.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose life total is less than or equal to Angelic Enforcer's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
That opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
